cáenlos: caer + los — they fall upon them, they pursue them (present 3rd pl. + object los; caer en alcaz 'to fall on in pursuit, give chase', an idiom whose sense is taken from context; cf. cade en alcança)
caer: caer — to fall (infinitive; veriedes caer 'you would see fall'; = caer)
migeros: migero — mile (pl.; Pidal's note: 'Siete millas completas duró la persecución'; = millas)
cadiól: caer + le — he fell upon him, went after him (preterite 3rd sg. cadió, the old form with -d-, + enclitic l(e) 'him'; caer a uno en alcaz 'to fall on someone in pursuit'; = le cayó)
torna: tornar — turn back, come back (imperative 2nd sg.; acá torna 'turn back here'; = vuelve)
venist: venir — you came (preterite 2nd sg., -ist ending; = viniste)
dalent: de + alent — from beyond (de + alent, old alén; dalent mar 'from over the sea'; = de allende)
veerte: veer + te — to see yourself, to meet (infinitive veer + reflexive te; veerte as con 'you will meet face to face with'; = verte)
as: aver — you have (present 2nd sg., = has); also the future auxiliary set after infinitive + clitic in the split future (veerte as 'you will see yourself', = te verás)
saludar: saludar — to greet (infinitive; saludar nos hemos 'we shall greet one another', split future; Pidal's note glosses the exchange as 'nos besaremos', 'we shall kiss'; = saludar)
tajaremos: tajar — we shall make, conclude (future 1st pl.; tajar amiztat 'to strike a friendship'; Pidal's note: 'pactaremos amistad'; literally 'to cut', sense taken from Pidal; = tajaremos)
amiztat: amiztad — friendship, pact of friendship (fem. noun, spelling variant with final t; Pidal's amizta[t]; = amistad)
cofonda: cofonder — may he confound, destroy (present subjunctive 3rd sg. in a curse; cofonda Dios 'may God confound'; = confunda, of confundir)
veot: veer + te — I see you (present 1st sg. veo + object te, the e of te run into the verb; veot aguijar 'I see you spurring'; = te veo)
quieres: querer — you want, intend (present 2nd sg.; la quieres ensayar 'you wish to try it out'; = quieres)
juntarás: juntar — you will join (future 2nd sg.; with reflexive te, juntarse con uno 'to come up with, catch up with someone': non te juntarás comigo 'you will not come up with me'; = (te) juntarás)
saltos: salto — leap, bound (pl.; grandes saltos faz 'makes great leaps'; = saltos)
alcançándolo: alcançar + lo — overtaking him, catching up with him (gerund + object lo; alcançándolo va 'goes along overtaking him'; = alcanzándolo)
alcançólo: alcançar + lo — he overtook him (preterite 3rd sg. alcançó + enclitic lo; = lo alcanzó)
braças: braça — fathom, an arm-spread measure of length (fem. pl.; a tres braças 'three arm-spans away'; = brazas, now 'fathoms'; exact length uncertain)
dádol: dar + le — given him (past part. dado + enclitic l(e) 'to him'; dádol ha, the perfect with the participle set before aver, 'he has given him'; = le ha dado)
tollidas: tollir — cut off, taken away (past part. fem. pl., agreeing with carbonclas; tollidas gelas ha 'has cut them off from him'; = quitadas)
librado: librar — freed, dispatched, cleared (past part. masc. sg.; librado todo lo al 'all the rest being dispatched/cut through'; sense uncertain)
tizón: Tizón — Tizón, the sword of King Búcar, won by the Cid (proper name; = Tizón)
vençió: vençer — he won, defeated (preterite 3rd sg.; vençió la batalla 'he won the battle'; = venció)
preçiava: preçiar — he valued, prized (imperfect 3rd sg.; = apreciaba)
vinía: venir — he came, was coming (imperfect 3rd sg., -ía ending; = venía)
soltado: soltar — loosened, let down (past part. masc. sg.; almófar soltado 'hood of mail thrown back'; = soltado)
pelos: pelo — hair (masc. pl., of the head; = pelos, cabello)
yaquanto: yaquanto — somewhat, a little (ya + quanto; Pidal 'algo'; della yaquanto 'somewhat of it'; = algo, un poco)
alegrós: alegrar + se — he rejoiced, was glad (preterite 3rd sg. alegró + reflexive se cut to s; = se alegró)
fio: fiar — I trust (present 1st sg.; fiar por Dios 'to trust in God'; = fío)
espadado: espadado — slashed with swords, hacked (past part. of an old verb espadar, Pidal's espad[ad]o; todo espadado of the shield; Pidal notes the wooden shield kept the marks of sword and lance blows; no modern verb, closest acuchillado)
logrado: lograr — achieved, got (past part. masc. sg.; non gelo avien logrado 'they had not got their way with it'; Pidal's note: 'no habían logrado su intento', 'no habían salido con la suya'; = logrado)
matado: matar — killed (past part. masc. sg.; ha moros matado 'has killed Moors', aver + participle; = matado)
matastes: matar — you killed (preterite 2nd pl., old -stes ending, used respectfully to one person; = matasteis)
arrancamos: arrancar — we routed, drove off (preterite 1st pl., in form also present; arrancar el canpo 'to rout the enemy from the field', win the battle; = derrotamos)
bienes: bien — goods, possessions, wealth (masc. pl. noun; todos estos bienes 'all this wealth'; = bienes)
ensayados: ensayar — having exerted themselves, proved (past part. masc. pl.; ensayarse 'to exert oneself in the fight, do deeds of prowess', with ser as perfect auxiliary: son ensayados 'have distinguished themselves', Pidal 'aquí se han distinguido'; = se han distinguido)
fartos: farto — sated, having had their fill (adj. masc. pl.; fartos de lidiar 'sated with fighting'; = hartos)
touieron: tener — they took (it) as, held (preterite 3rd pl., strong; lo touieron a escarnio 'took it as mockery'; = tuvieron)
escarnio: escarnio — mockery, derision (masc. noun; tener a escarnio 'to take as mockery'; Pidal's restoration [escarnio], the whole word; = escarnio)
cadie: caer — it fell to, came to (imperfect 3rd sg., -ie ending with -d- kept; Pidal's ca[di]e; a la raçión cadie 'to each share fell'; = caía)
cuydaron: cuydar — they thought, supposed (preterite 3rd pl.; cuydaron que 'they thought that'; = cuidaron, archaic for 'pensaron')
minguados: minguar — lacking, in want, diminished (past part. masc. pl.; nunqua serien minguados 'they would never be in want'; = menguados)
arreados: arrear — equipped, furnished, adorned (past part. masc. pl.; muy bien arreados 'very well furnished'; = arreados)
sazones: sazón — season, due time (fem. pl.; a sazones, 'in season, at the right times', of provisions; Pidal's page gives no note on this verse, sense taken from context; = sazones, a su tiempo)
pieles: piel — skin, fur, pelt (fem. pl.; buenas pieles 'good furs'; = pieles)

__broaden__.tienes: tener + se — he holds himself (present 3rd sg. tiene + reflexive se, the e of se run into tiene; tener por 'to consider as'; = se tiene) · also tener — you hold, have (present 2nd sg.; espada tienes en mano 'you hold a sword in hand'; = tienes)
__broaden__.val: valer — help! (imperative 2nd sg., apocopated for vale; = vale) · val — valley (noun, = valle; el val de río Martín 'the valley of the river Martín') · also valer — he helps, avails (present 3rd sg., apocopated for vale; si no nos val 'if he does not help us'; = vale) · also valer — it is worth (present 3rd sg., apocopated; que mill marcos d'oro val 'which is worth a thousand marks of gold'; = vale)
__broaden__.llegado: llegar — arrived (past part.; era llegado 'had arrived', ser as perfect auxiliary; = llegado) · also llegar — llegado ha 'has reached' (past part. before aver as perfect auxiliary; fata la çintura el espada llegado ha 'the sword has reached down to the waist')
__broaden__.faz: faz — face (fem.; = faz, cara) · also fazer — he makes (present 3rd sg., apocopated; grandes saltos faz 'makes great leaps'; = hace)
__broaden__.cade: caer — falls (present 3rd sg., cade with its -d- kept; Pidal's restoration [cade]; cade en alcança 'falls in pursuit', i.e. gives chase, an idiom whose sense is taken from context; = cae) · also caer — falls down, stumbles (literal sense, present 3rd sg.; o comigo non cade 'or does not fall with me'; = cae)
__broaden__.avien: aver — they had (imperfect 3rd pl.; = avían/habían) · also aver — they had (auxiliary of the pluperfect before the participle; non gelo avien logrado 'they had not achieved it'; = habían)
__broaden__.así: así — thus, so; así como 'as soon as' · also así commo — as, just as (así commo semeja 'as it seems'; = así como)
__broaden__.te: te — you, thee (2nd sg. object pronoun) · also te — reflexive 'yourself' (non te juntarás 'you will not join yourself, come up with'; = te)
__broaden__.salvo: salvo — safety, safe-keeping (noun; en vuestro salvo 'in your safe keeping') · also adjective, safe, saved (por end es salvo de mal 'for that reason he is saved from evil') · en so salvo — in his own hands, in safekeeping (Pidal's note on lo tenien en so salvo: 'en su poder', 'en seguridad'; = en su poder)
__broaden__.raçión: raçión — share, portion (fem. noun; non ayan i raçión, Pidal 'no tomen parte en la batalla'; closest parte; not the modern 'ration') · a la raçión — to each share (a la raçión cadie 'to each share fell'; Pidal: the booty was divided into raciones, afterwards shared out in proportion among the fighters)
__broaden__.recabdo: recabdo — care, precaution, strict order (= recaudo) · also recabdo — business secured, a sure outcome (con todo buen recabdo 'with everything well in hand') · recabdo — account, reckoning (oro e plata que non saben recabdo 'gold and silver past all reckoning') · also con recabdo — within bounds, under control (non es con recabdo el dolor de Valençia 'the grief of Valencia is past all bounds') · also todo el recabdo está 'every precaution is taken' (Pidal: 'hay toda clase de precauciones'; en Medina todo el recabdo está) · also non avie recabdo — there was no counting or reckoning (de los colpes de las lanças non avie recabdo 'the lance blows could not be reckoned'; sense uncertain, from the 'account, reckoning' sense; Pidal gives no note here)
__broaden__.ganados: ganar — gained, earned (past part. masc. pl., agreeing with its object, as with ovo bastidos; avien ganados = habían ganado) · also ganados — gains, spoils (noun, masc. pl.; Pidal 'ganancias': los ganados que fizo 'the gains he made'; = ganancias) · also ganados — as a noun, winnings, spoils (todos los ganados 'all the booty'; Pidal's note: 'ganancias', v. 481)
__broaden__.algo: algo — something; the poem's discreet word for money, wealth · also algo — somewhat, something (algo vidie 'he saw something', i.e. something of what pleased him); que él preçiava algo, 'which he prized not a little' (sense uncertain)
__broaden__.de: de — of, from · also de — by (the agent with a passive participle; = por) · also de — 'by (night)' (de noch), partitive 'of, among' (quinze moros … de los que alcançava; pocas de gentes), 'as' (de ganançia 'as booty'), 'from outside' (de fuera), 'on the right' (de diestro) · also 'about, concerning' (de mí non digan mal 'let them not speak ill of me') · also de — 'as if in' (commo de arrancada 'as if in rout'); 'in the manner of' (de guisa 'in such a way'); 'of, among' (de bivos pocos 'of the living few'); nominalized infinitive (del prender 'of the taking') · also de — 'with' of manner (de fuertes coraçones 'with stout hearts'); 'on' (de pie 'on foot'); 'from' of side (della e della part 'from both sides'); de cabo 'anew' (de + cabo, 'again'); de suso de 'above'; seños … de seños colpes 'with one blow each' · also de — 'in respect of' after an adjective (sobejana de mala 'exceedingly bad'); 'with regard to, about' (me plaze de mio Çid 'I am pleased about the Cid'); 'from, at the hand of' (de señor non ha graçia 'he gets no favor from a lord'); 'from' of origin (de moros fo 'it came from Moors'); 'at' of manner (de vagar 'at leisure', de + the noun vagar) · also de’ — Pidal's de’llaño, read as del llaño 'of the plain' (the article's l run into the ll; a reading, not certain) · de + infinitive after an adjective (de ir somos guisados 'we are ready to go') · also de + infinitive after a verb: començar de 'to begin to' (compeçó de fablar 'he began to speak'), piénssanse de 'set about' (piénssanse de armar), aver de 'to have to' (lo que ha de far 'what he has to do') · also de — 'within' of a time limit (De aquestos quinze días, most likely 'within these fifteen days'; sense uncertain); de veluntad 'willingly'; de + superlative partitive (de los mejores guarnimientos 'of the best equipment') · also de — 'with, from' of the means or source (diziendo de la boca 'saying with his mouth'; de cuer les pesa 'it grieves them from the heart') · also de que 'of whom, of which' (relative after a noun; de moros de que non avien sabor 'of Moors they had no taste for') · de firme 'steadfastly, with a will' (de firme robavan el campo); de + noun of material, 'in' (de plata seys çientos marcos 'six hundred marks in silver'); of possession, 'belonging to' (de vos son 'are yours'); fartos de lidiar 'sated with fighting'; pagado de 'pleased with'
__broaden__.e: e — and (= modern y) · also aver — I have (1st sg. present, apocopated form of he, perfect auxiliary: Espeso e el oro, 'I have spent the gold') · also aver — 'I will', the future auxiliary in a split future (quitarvos e … darvos e de mano 'I will free you … I will let you go'; = vos quitaré, vos daré) · also the full verb 'I have' (el sabor que dend e 'the delight I have of it') · also e — pleonastic 'and' joining two names of the one person (a Dios e al padre 'to God, the Father'; Pidal 'conjunción e pleonástica', cf. v. 300)
__broaden__.della: de + ella — 'from/of her/it' (contraction); della e della part, 'from the one and the other side', i.e. from all sides (= de ella, here de una y otra parte) · also della yaquanto — 'somewhat of it' (de + ella + yaquanto, Pidal 'algo': cofia … fronzida della yaquanto, the coif gathered a little)
__broaden__.muchos: mucho — many (masc. pl.; = muchos) · also muchos — 'very', the adverb mucho agreeing with a plural subject (Muchos son alegres 'very glad are they'; = muy)
__broaden__.preçiados: preçiado — valuable, precious (adj. masc. pl.; from preçiar; = preciados) · also preçiados — esteemed, held in honour, of men (adelant serán preçiados 'hereafter they will be esteemed'; = apreciados)
__broaden__.avie: aver — he had (imperfect; unaccented spelling beside avié) · also aver — impersonal temporal 'it had been' (passado avie tres años 'three years had passed'; = hacía/habían pasado) · also avie — impersonal 'there was' (non avie recabdo 'there was no reckoning'; = había)
